They handed me this and asked what I think of it. First thing I'd say to whoever wrote it: you don't know me, or you would not have put down that marriage and partnerships read well. I was married twice and both of them ended, and the whole world knows what happened after the second one. Same page says home and property read well. I lost Rockingham. They foreclosed on it and then they knocked it down. So on the two things every living person knows about my life, this thing is backwards.

Where it lands, though, it lands. Children and learning read hard: I buried a baby girl in 1979 and there is nothing that ever happened to me, before or since, that touched that. And I never finished at 'SC. Illness, debts and rivals read hard: I have had a judgment on my back since 1997 that grows every year whether I earn a dollar or not, and I have had more men making a living out of being against me than I could name. Big changes and difficult passages read hard. Nine years in Lovelock. That is a passage.

The part about me being quick with words, good with people, good at dealing. Sure. That is true, and I made a living off it in a booth and in front of a camera when football was done with me. It is also true of every man I ever shook hands with in that business. Any one of them could read that paragraph and say that is me.

It says right now is a strong stretch and everything is live. I am seventy-six years old with cancer, so I will let that one go by. Maybe it is describing the man I was at forty. At forty, most of that page was true.

On the record, since you are writing this down: I was acquitted in 1995. The Nevada thing I have said my piece about, I went in there after property that belonged to me and it cost me nine years of my life. None of that is on this page either way, which I notice. What is not on the page at all is anything about the four kids of mine still living, and a man's real accounting is in them, not in a list of twelve headings.

notes: Answered in persona as O.J. Simpson (b. 9 Jul 1947 San Francisco, AA birth-certificate time 8:08am; d. 10 Apr 2024, Las Vegas, prostate cancer), answering at the end of his life. Biography anchors: childhood rickets and leg braces, Potrero Hill projects, father Jimmy Lee left the household c.1952 and died of AIDS in 1986, mother Eunice a hospital orderly, third of four children; Galileo High, juvenile detention at 15, City College of SF then USC, Heisman 1968, no completed degree; Bills 1969-77 (2,003 yards and MVP 1973), 49ers 1978-79, Hall of Fame 1985; Hertz, ABC/NBC broadcasting, film work; Marguerite Whitley 1967-79 with Arnelle, Jason and Aaren (drowned 1979); Nicole Brown 1985-92 with Sydney and Justin; 1989 no-contest plea to spousal battery; 1994 murders and arrest, 1995 acquittal, 1997 civil judgment of $33.5M unsatisfied at death, Rockingham lost 1998; 2007 Las Vegas incident, 2008 conviction, nine years at Lovelock, paroled Oct 2017, discharged Dec 2021; cancer disclosed 2023. Where I felt pull from the reading and refused it: the reading calls marriage and partnerships, home/property/mother, work and standing, and income/gains/friends FAVOURABLE, and I answered C9 (home), C10 (spouse), C11 (partnership) and C5 (friends) as difficulties anyway, because the divorces, the 1989 battery plea, the foreclosure, the associates who testified against him in Nevada, and the collapse of every commercial relationship after 1994 are the record. C5 and C11 are the two that genuinely felt like coin tosses (he was never without an entourage, and Hertz/ABC were real successes) so those carry confidence 3 and 2 rather than a guessed-high number. Where my answers agree with the reading (C1/C8 schooling and higher study as difficulties, C6 confinement, C12 inheritance, A23 debt) they were derived from the biography first: the junior-college route, the unfinished degree, 474 days in county jail plus nine years in Nevada, no inheritance and an estate consumed by the judgment. The reading's one distinctive claim, that it is unusually negative about the father, happens to match a father who left when he was about five, so A10 is 'absent' on the record, not on the reading's say-so. D1 marks the plain reading and the house list as plainly wrong precisely on marriage and home. Only the plain-English page and the twelve-matters list were present in the supplied reading, so D1-D4 are answered about those and the 'right now' list only; the longevity, medical, marriage, children, profession, wealth, divisional, karmic and nichod chapters named in the D options were not in the text and are not ticked. 115 answer keys total.
